title: CareGap synthetic evaluation set v1
description: Internal synthetic consultation pairs for status evaluation. Not expert-reviewed. Not for live accuracy claims without controlled runs.
split_policy: Approx 60% dev / 20% val / 20% test. Cases sharing family_id stay in one split. Do not tune prompts on test.
